evidence: Sanitized inventory derived from a live probe of `opencode serve` 1.18.31 on loopback: OpenAPI 3.1 document at /doc plus the SSE stream at /event. Contains no credentials, tokens, API keys or user data.

authentication.note: Loopback instances are unsecured by default. Optional HTTP basic auth is enabled by setting OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD (username defaults to `opencode`, override with OPENCODE_SERVER_USERNAME). Values are never stored in fixtures or logs.

eventStream.acceptedEncoding: Each SSE data payload is a JSON object with `type` and `properties`.

runtimeSchemaSource: /doc (OpenAPI 3.1) of the managed instance; request/response schemas are resolved at runtime during capability probe, not hard-coded from this snapshot.

missingOperations.description: The generic server API exposes no operation to pin a provider account or to disable plugin auto-rotation for a GUI-managed session.
missingOperations.impact: Multi-account routing cannot be enforced through generic endpoints; a plugin-specific bridge is required (TECHNICAL_SPECIFICATION.md §6.4).
missingOperations.fallback: Plugin-specific bridge; plugins without pin support stay exposed as one opaque provider route.

missingOperations.description: No generic endpoint returns the account/model/variant actually used for a turn.
missingOperations.impact: RouteMismatch cannot be proven without plugin evidence; execution must not be counted as success.
missingOperations.fallback: Plugin evidence or opaque execution; no automatic multi-account routing for plugins without evidence.

missingOperations.description: No generic quota endpoint exists in the discovered inventory.
missingOperations.impact: Quota rows for non-reporting sources must stay Unknown/Unsupported, never fabricated.
missingOperations.fallback: Plugin-specific quota adapters; manual/local counters explicitly marked as local or estimated.

missingOperations.description: No explicit session close/reset operation was part of the discovered inventory.
missingOperations.impact: Reset must be implemented as a new native session with ancestry until a close/delete capability is confirmed.
missingOperations.fallback: New session preserving history; Phase 3 must re-probe /doc for a delete/close operation.

missingOperations.description: session.abort only acknowledges the request; the terminal outcome is delivered through the event stream.
missingOperations.impact: The Execution Watchdog must reconcile Cancelling to Cancelled or Ambiguous.
missingOperations.fallback: Bounded forced termination of the managed execution with post-cancel session reconciliation.

missingOperations.description: A server restart loses an in-flight turn; no in-flight prompt resume is defined.
missingOperations.impact: Restart requires reconciliation outcomes Reattached, Orphaned, Ambiguous or BackendMissing (TECHNICAL_SPECIFICATION.md §6.7).
missingOperations.fallback: Session reconciliation; no automatic prompt resend.

missingOperations.description: Endpoint paths and event names are version-specific; public documentation tracks newer versions than 1.18.31.
missingOperations.impact: This snapshot is evidence, not a permanent contract.
missingOperations.fallback: Adapter probes /doc and capabilities at startup; mandatory operations missing produce UnsupportedVersion instead of a silent fallback.
